definitions.explanation: Doing something with great care and attention to detail, often implying patient, persistent effort. Composed of 丹 (red, sincere) + 念 (thought, attention).

examples.japanese: {丹念|たんねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{磨|みが}いた→磨く：02427_migaku⟧。
⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{丹念|たんねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げた→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a work finished meticulously by a craftsman.

examples.japanese: ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{丹念|たんねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{判明|はんめい}→判明：11785_hanmei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of carefully examining the materials, new facts came to light.

notes:
USAGE:
{丹念|たんねん} is used both as a na-adjective ({丹念|たんねん}な) and as an adverb ({丹念|たんねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧). It emphasizes persistent, careful attention to detail, often in craftsmanship or research.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丹念|たんねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧ (to examine carefully)
- {丹念|たんねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make with great care)
- {丹念|たんねん}な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ (meticulous work)
- {丹念|たんねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧ (to polish carefully)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧ means careful or polite and is more common in everyday speech. {丹念|たんねん} implies deeper dedication and persistence, often used for artistic or scholarly work.
